blurb: Hoboken Cove Community Boathouse is a volunteer-based non-profit providing free kayaking, stand up paddle boarding, and outrigger canoeing in a protected cove. They offer free paddle days for all ages and river trips for bigger adventures. They also organize volunteer trips and community events like litter pick-ups and races.
